Privacy Policy for PostFlow

Last updated: October 2026

PostFlow respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data.

1. Information We Collect

We only collect data necessary to publish content on your authorized Facebook Pages (Page ID, Page Access Tokens).

2. How We Use Information

Your tokens are stored locally on your server and are only used to authenticate Facebook Graph API calls on your behalf.

3. Data Deletion

You can remove your connected Facebook Pages and tokens at any time directly through your PostFlow settings dashboard.

4. Contact Us

If you have any questions, contact us at danisahib0@gmail.com.
